Management Consulting


# About ZAPPY AI



ZAPPY AI is a premium operational consulting partner serving industrial and high-tech organizations that demand measurable results. We deliver end-to-end expertise across supply chain management, procurement, subcontracting, manufacturing operations, and NSI process management — helping organizations reduce costs, compress lead times, and build resilient supplier networks.


Our consultants bring executive-level authority and hands-on operational experience to every engagement. Whether you operate in defense, electronics, medical devices, or advanced manufacturing, we embed within your organization to diagnose inefficiencies, design scalable solutions, and drive execution with the precision your operations require. As a trusted supply chain management consulting firm, we combine strategic thinking with rigorous on-the-ground delivery.







































## Built on Hands-On Operational Experience


### Strategy Backed by Execution


ZAPPY AI was founded on a simple conviction: that effective supply chain management consulting must go beyond frameworks and slide decks. Our consultants bring direct operational involvement — embedding alongside your teams to diagnose root causes, redesign processes, and drive measurable improvements in cost, lead time, and supplier performance.


We combine strategic thinking with rigorous execution. Whether restructuring a procurement function, rationalizing a supplier base, or managing complex subcontracting across defense or medical device programs, we align every stakeholder around shared performance goals — and stay accountable until results are delivered.


Our clients gain more than a consulting engagement — they gain an operational partner who understands the pressures of industrial environments and has the experience to navigate them with precision, speed, and lasting impact.


Explore Our Approach


















## How We Work


Six core principles that define our approach to supply chain management consulting and operational excellence delivery.










### Real Operational Experience


Our consultants bring direct, hands-on industry experience from the factory floor to the boardroom — not theoretical frameworks alone.










### End-to-End Execution Capability


We manage the full project lifecycle — from initial assessment through implementation and performance tracking — without handoffs that lose momentum.










### Deep Supply Chain Expertise


Specialized knowledge across procurement, subcontracting, logistics, and supplier networks positions us as a trusted partner in supply chain management consulting services.










### Hands-On Management Approach


We embed within your operations to drive change from the inside, ensuring recommendations translate into real, sustainable process improvements.










### Fast Problem Solving


We diagnose operational bottlenecks rapidly and deploy targeted solutions that deliver measurable impact within compressed timelines.










### Results-Driven Methodology


Every engagement is anchored to quantifiable KPIs — cost reduction, lead time improvement, and supplier performance — so outcomes are always measurable.





















## Executive Standards,Operational Discipline.


At ZAPPY AI, our supply chain management consulting practice is built on a foundation of non-negotiable professional standards. We operate with the same rigor we demand from the systems we optimize — bringing structured thinking, evidence-led decision-making, and executive accountability to every engagement.


These principles are not aspirational. They are the operating standards by which our consultants are measured and by which our clients achieve lasting, measurable improvement.


Our Approach













### Accountability Without Exception


Every engagement commitment is tracked, reported, and owned. Our consultants hold themselves to the same performance metrics we establish for client operations.












### Precision Over Approximation


We do not estimate where we can measure. Data integrity, process accuracy, and analytical rigor underpin every recommendation we deliver to operations and procurement leadership.












### Supplier Partnership as Strategy


Supplier relationships are competitive assets. We build structured partnership frameworks that elevate supplier performance, reduce risk, and create sustainable cost and quality advantages.












### Manufacturing Reliability as Baseline


In defense, electronics, and medical device environments, operational reliability is non-negotiable. We engineer processes and controls that deliver consistent output across complex, regulated manufacturing contexts.












### Measurable Improvement Culture


Transformation is not a project — it is a discipline. We instill continuous improvement frameworks that outlast our engagements, embedding a culture of measurement, iteration, and operational excellence within client organizations.

What We Do


# Our Services



ZAPPY AI is your end-to-end supply chain management consulting partner — delivering structured operational expertise across procurement, subcontracting, manufacturing operations, and supplier performance for industrial and high-tech organizations. We translate strategy into measurable results: reduced costs, shorter lead times, and resilient supply networks built for the demands of defense, electronics, and medical device sectors.














## Our Capabilities


End-to-end supply chain management consulting services — from strategic sourcing to operational execution — delivered with precision across industrial and high-tech sectors.






01


## Supply Chain Management


We design and optimize end-to-end supply chains for industrial and high-tech organizations — reducing lead times, improving supplier reliability, and building resilient networks that perform under pressure. Our approach integrates strategic planning with hands-on operational execution.


- Supply chain mapping & network design

- Inventory optimization & demand planning

- Supplier performance management & KPI frameworks

- Lead time reduction programs

- Risk assessment & supply chain resilience

- Digital supply chain transformation


















02


## Procurement & Strategic Sourcing


Our procurement practice drives measurable cost reduction and supplier quality improvement through disciplined strategic sourcing. We build category strategies, run competitive RFQ processes, and negotiate contracts that protect your margins while securing supply continuity across defense, electronics, and medical device sectors.


- Category management & spend analysis

- Competitive RFQ & supplier qualification

- Contract negotiation & total cost of ownership

- Make vs. buy analysis & sourcing strategy

- Supplier development & dual-source programs

- Procurement process digitization & ERP integration










03


## Subcontracting & Assembly Operations


We manage the full lifecycle of subcontracting relationships — from initial vendor selection and work-package definition through quality oversight and delivery acceptance. Our team embeds directly into your operations to ensure subcontractors meet technical, schedule, and cost requirements without exception.


- Subcontractor selection & onboarding

- Work-package definition & SOW development

- Assembly line setup & production readiness reviews

- Quality assurance & inspection management

- Schedule adherence & milestone tracking

- NSI process management & end-to-end coordination


















04


## Operational Consulting


Our operational consulting practice embeds experienced practitioners directly into your organization to diagnose inefficiencies, redesign workflows, and implement sustainable performance improvements. We deliver measurable outcomes — cost reduction, throughput gains, and quality improvements — across manufacturing, logistics, and procurement functions.


- Operational diagnostics & performance benchmarking

- Process redesign & lean manufacturing

- Cost reduction & efficiency improvement programs

- KPI design & management reporting systems

- Change management & organizational capability building

- Executive reporting & board-level operational strategy























## How Engagements Move Forward


Our supply chain management consulting methodology is structured for clarity, accountability, and measurable impact — from initial diagnosis through sustained performance improvement.










01





### Assess Current Operations


We conduct a rigorous diagnostic of your operations — mapping workflows, identifying inefficiencies, and benchmarking against industry standards to establish a clear performance baseline.










02





### Identify Constraints & Cost Drivers


We pinpoint the root causes of cost escalation, lead time delays, and supplier underperformance — translating complex operational data into prioritized action targets.










03





### Align Stakeholders & Suppliers


We facilitate structured alignment sessions across internal teams, procurement functions, and supplier networks — ensuring all parties are committed to shared objectives and timelines.










04





### Implement Recovery & Optimization


Our consultants work hands-on to deploy corrective actions, renegotiate procurement terms, restructure subcontracting workflows, and drive manufacturing improvements with precision.










05





### Track Measurable Outcomes


We establish KPI dashboards and review cadences that quantify cost reduction, lead time improvement, and supplier performance gains — delivering the evidence your leadership team requires.
























## What Clients Gain


Our supply chain management consulting services deliver measurable operational impact across every dimension of your business — from procurement to the production floor.













### Reduced Operational Cost


Clients consistently achieve 10–25% cost reduction through targeted procurement optimization, supplier renegotiation, and waste elimination across the supply chain.











### Improved Lead Time


Streamlined sourcing pipelines and proactive supplier management compress lead times, enabling faster time-to-market and more agile production scheduling.











### Stronger Supplier Performance


Structured KPI frameworks and active supplier development programs elevate quality standards, reduce non-conformances, and build long-term partnership reliability.











### Better Delivery Accuracy


End-to-end scheduling discipline and subcontractor oversight translate into on-time delivery rates that protect program commitments and customer satisfaction.











### Stronger Operational Visibility


Real-time dashboards and structured reporting give leadership clear sight lines into inventory positions, supplier status, and production throughput at every stage.











### Resilient Manufacturing Execution


Robust process controls and contingency planning harden your manufacturing operations against disruption, ensuring consistent output quality in defense, electronics, and medical device environments.

- Supplier reliability & lead time control

### Medical Devices


Medical device supply chains require zero-defect quality discipline and full traceability. We implement ISO 13485-aligned procurement and manufacturing processes that satisfy regulatory bodies and protect patient safety.


- ISO 13485 & FDA compliance support

- Quality discipline & supplier audits

- Full traceability & documentation

- Precision assembly subcontracting












### Logistics & Distribution

- Distribution network optimization

- 3PL & carrier performance management

- Inbound & outbound coordination

























## Common Operational Challenges We Address


Across supply chain management consulting and industrial operations, organizations face recurring structural gaps that erode performance, inflate cost, and expose risk. We identify and resolve them with precision.




6
Core challenge domains


100%
Measurable resolution focus













### Fragmented Supplier Performance


Supplier networks operating without unified KPIs, inconsistent quality standards, and limited visibility create cascading disruptions across the supply chain. Without structured performance frameworks, procurement leaders cannot enforce accountability or drive continuous improvement across their vendor base.

Supplier Management









### Inventory Imbalance


Chronic overstocking in low-velocity categories alongside stockouts in critical components reflects misaligned replenishment logic and weak demand signal integration. The result is tied-up capital and production stoppages occurring simultaneously.

Inventory Optimization









### Weak Demand Alignment


Sales forecasts disconnected from operations planning generate reactive procurement cycles, excess safety stock, and missed delivery windows. Supply chain management consulting engagements consistently reveal this as the highest-impact root cause of cost overruns.

Demand Planning









### Production Transfer Risk


Moving production lines between facilities or suppliers without structured transfer protocols introduces quality escapes, schedule delays, and knowledge loss. Defense, medical device, and electronics manufacturers face regulatory and contractual exposure when transfers are managed informally. A disciplined NSI process is essential to de-risk the transition and protect delivery commitments.

Manufacturing Operations









### Subcontracting Visibility Gaps


Tier-2 and tier-3 subcontractors operating outside formal reporting structures create blind spots in schedule, quality, and compliance. Without active subcontracting governance, prime contractors absorb risk they cannot see or manage.

Subcontracting









### Delivery Inconsistency


Variable on-time delivery rates undermine customer trust and internal scheduling confidence. Root causes typically span supplier lead time volatility, internal capacity misalignment, and logistics coordination failures — requiring a systemic rather than transactional response.

Delivery Performance



















## Why Sector Leaders Engage Us


In defense, electronics, and medical devices, operational precision is non-negotiable. We deliver the structured expertise that complex industrial environments demand — with measurable outcomes at every engagement.










01




### Regulatory Discipline in High-Stakes Environments


Operating in regulated industries — defense procurement, medical device manufacturing, aerospace-grade electronics — demands more than process knowledge. It requires a consulting partner who understands AS9100, ISO 13485, ITAR compliance, and government contracting standards from the inside. Our supply chain management consulting practice embeds regulatory rigor at every stage of engagement: from supplier qualification and audit readiness to documentation governance and corrective action management. Clients avoid costly non-conformances and gain the confidence that comes from structured, defensible operational frameworks.












02




### Cross-Functional Execution Across the Enterprise


Operational improvement rarely lives in a single department. True performance gains emerge when procurement, engineering, quality, and production leadership operate from a unified execution framework. ZAPPY AI bridges these functions — translating strategic objectives into coordinated operational action across every stakeholder. Our consultants have led cross-functional transformation programs in organizations ranging from mid-tier industrial manufacturers to global Tier-1 suppliers, consistently reducing lead times, eliminating redundancy, and improving on-time delivery performance by double-digit margins. The result is an organization that executes with clarity rather than fragmentation.












03




### Supplier-to-Production Integration at Scale


The gap between supplier performance and production output is where operational costs accumulate and delivery commitments break down. Our end-to-end supply chain management consulting services close this gap by redesigning supplier relationships, subcontracting structures, and inbound material flows to align directly with production schedules and quality gates. We implement supplier scorecards, capacity planning protocols, and escalation mechanisms that give operations leaders real-time visibility and proactive control. Clients in electronics assembly and medical device production have achieved measurable reductions in incoming defect rates, buffer inventory, and unplanned production stoppages — delivering the kind of structured operational performance that sustains competitive advantage.

## Case Studies in Operational Transformation


Three engagements. Measurable outcomes. A consistent methodology rooted in supply chain management consulting and hands-on operational execution.









Supply Chain Management

## Recovering a Fractured Supply Chain in Defense Electronics





### Challenge


A tier-1 defense electronics manufacturer faced severe supplier fragmentation across 14 critical commodity families. Procurement lead times had extended to 28+ weeks, buffer stocks were depleted, and on-time delivery to program milestones had dropped below 61%.





### Actions Taken


ZAPPY AI deployed a cross-functional supply chain recovery program: supplier segmentation, dual-sourcing protocols for high-risk components, and a centralized demand-signal system connecting procurement to production scheduling in real time.





### Outcomes


- 38% reduction in average procurement lead time within 6 months

- +24 pts improvement in on-time delivery to program milestones

- 2× increase in qualified alternate suppliers per critical commodity

- $2.1M in annualized inventory carrying cost reduction

Procurement Optimization

## Structural Cost Reduction Across an Industrial Procurement Portfolio





### Challenge


A mid-sized industrial manufacturer operating across three production sites had accumulated a fragmented supplier base of 340+ vendors with no category management discipline. Procurement costs were 18% above benchmark, and maverick spend accounted for nearly a third of total purchasing volume.





### Actions Taken


We executed a full spend-cube analysis, introduced category management across 8 strategic commodity families, rationalized the vendor base by 42%, and negotiated consolidated volume agreements with preferred suppliers — integrating new SLA frameworks and performance scorecards.





### Outcomes


- 14.6% net procurement cost reduction in Year 1

- 42% vendor base rationalization improving contract leverage

- –31% maverick spend through category governance rollout

- 96% of preferred suppliers meeting new SLA thresholds














Manufacturing Operations

## Stabilizing Subcontracting Operations in Medical Device Manufacturing





### Challenge


A medical device OEM relying on a network of subcontractors for precision machining and assembly experienced cascading delivery failures. Subcontractor quality escapes had increased 3× year-over-year, creating regulatory exposure and threatening two major program deliveries.





### Actions Taken


ZAPPY AI embedded a dedicated subcontracting management team on-site, restructured subcontractor qualification requirements, introduced first-article inspection protocols, and deployed a real-time production visibility dashboard linked to the client's ERP — enabling proactive escalation before schedule slippage occurred.





### Outcomes


- –78% quality escape rate within 90 days of engagement

- +19 pts improvement in subcontractor on-time delivery rate

- 100% on-time delivery achieved for both critical program milestones

- 3.2 wks average lead time reduction across precision machining suppliers

90-Day Turnaround

–78%

# Privacy Policy



Last Updated:  5/22/2026



ZAPPY AI ("Company", "we", "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information when you use our website [business_website] ("Service").


## 1. Information Collection


We may collect the following types of information:


- Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number and address

- Technical Information: IP address, browser type, operating system and website usage data

- Cookies: Information stored on your computer to improve user experience




## 2. Use of Information


We use the collected information for the following purposes:


- Providing requested services

- Improving service and user experience

- Contacting you regarding our services

- Compliance with legal requirements




## 3. Information Sharing


We do not sell, rent or share your personal information with third parties, except in the following cases:


- With your explicit consent

- When required by law

- To protect our rights or user safety

- With service providers who assist in operating the service (under confidentiality agreements)




## 4. User Rights


In accordance with Israeli Privacy Protection Law 1981, you have the following rights:


- Right to access personal information stored about you

- Right to correct inaccurate or incomplete information

- Right to delete personal information in certain circumstances

- Right to object to information processing for marketing purposes

- Right to file a complaint with the Data Protection Authority




## 5. Cookies


Our website uses cookies to improve user experience. You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect website functionality.


## 6. Information Security


We implement reasonable security measures to protect your information, including encryption, firewalls and restricted access control. However, no transmission or storage method is 100% secure.


## 7. Policy Changes


We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Material changes will be posted on the website with 30 days advance notice.



## 8. Contact Information

# Accessibility Statement



Last updated:  May 22, 2026



ZAPPY AI is committed to making our services accessible to all users. We strive to implement the Israeli Standard (TI 5568) based on WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines.


Accessibility Level: AA (Israeli Standard TI 5568)



## 1. Accessibility Policy


We believe in equal rights and the right of every person to receive information and services independently and equally. This website was designed and built with special emphasis on accessibility for people with disabilities.


## 2. Accessibility Arrangements on the Site


- Keyboard navigation support

- Screen reader compatibility

- Appropriate color contrast

- Flexible and scalable font sizes

- Descriptive image alt text

- Hierarchical heading structure

- Clear and descriptive links

- Support for 200% zoom without content loss





### WCAG 2.1 Compliance


The website complies with WCAG 2.1 Level AA, which includes:


- Perceivable: Information is presented in ways users can perceive

- Operable: Interface components are operable

- Understandable: Information and user interface are understandable

- Robust: Content can be interpreted by a variety of technologies





## 3. Supported Assistive Technologies


- NVDA (Windows)

- JAWS (Windows)

- VoiceOver (Mac/iOS)

- TalkBack (Android)

- Dragon NaturallySpeaking

- Switch navigation




## 4. Accessibility Testing


The website has been tested using:


- Automated accessibility testing tools

- Manual testing with screen readers

- Keyboard-only navigation

- Color contrast verification

- Testing with users with disabilities




## 5. Continuous Improvements


We are continuously working to improve the accessibility of our website and update it according to technological developments and user feedback.



## 6. Contact and Feedback


If you encounter an accessibility issue on the site or need assistance, please contact us:


- Company: ZAPPY AI

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]



Response time: We respond to accessibility inquiries within 3 business days and work to resolve issues within 10 business days.
